source: onboarding: Edgewater Park Township School District

schools.name: Mildred Magowan Elementary School
schools.absence_instructions: Call before 10:00 AM on each day of absence; if the absence will last more than one day, tell the office so further calls aren't needed. For a religious holiday, send a note or email to the main office in advance.

sacc.late_pickup_policy: Extended Day Care closes at 6:00 PM. Two courtesy late pickups a year if picked up by 6:15 PM; after that $10 for the first 15 minutes and $1 a minute, with suspension after repeated late pickups.
sacc.pickup_change_procedure: Email or call the EDC office ((609) 267-1406 ext. 2004) for any schedule or pickup change, not the school's main office. Changes to who may pick up must be sent to the EDC office in writing by email.
sacc.closures_notes: Extended Day Care is run by Lumberton Township School District for Edgewater Park and held at Magowan School. Registration and scheduling through EZChildTrack. No afternoon care on the first day, the half days before holidays or the last day; on a weather early dismissal care closes two hours after school does; closed on snow days and extended holidays. Opens later on a delayed opening (the program page says 9:00 AM, its handbook 8:35 AM).
